It provides [[information technology]], [[consulting]] and [[business process]] services, and is one of India's [[Big Tech (India)|Big Six]] IT services companies. Wipro's services include [[cloud computing]], [[computer security]], [[digital transformation]], [[artificial intelligence]], [[robotics]], [[data analytics]], and other technologies.{{Cite web |title=Fitch Affirms Wipro at 'A-'; Outlook Stable |url=https://www.fitchratings.com/research/corporate-finance/fitch-affirms-wipro-at-a-outlook-stable-28-03-2022 |access-date=2023-09-28 |website=www.fitchratings.com}} ==History== ===Early years=== The company was incorporated on 29 December 1945 in [[Amalner]] by MH Hasham Premji as '''Western India Vegetable Products Limited''', a manufacturer of [[cooking oil]]s. In 1966, after Hasham Premji's death, his son [[Azim Premji]] took over as [[chairperson]] at age 21. The company changed its name to '''Wipro Products Limited''' in 1977, followed by Wipro Limited, a [[syllabic abbreviation]] of the original name, in 1982. ===Shift to IT=== In the 1980s, recognizing opportunities in computer hardware and software, the company established subsidiaries Wipro Infotech and Wipro Systems. In 1981, Wipro developed the first Indian [[minicomputer]] based on the [[Intel 8086]] chip in an [[IISc]] lab.{{cite news |title=Wipro's early years |url=https://in.rediff.com/money/2006/jul/20sld1.htm |access-date=16 July 2024 |work=Rediff |date=20 July 2006}}{{cite news |title=Indian IT's pioneering pivot |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/startups/people/indian-its-pioneering-pivot/articleshow/99356730.cms |access-date=16 July 2024 |work=The Times of India |date=9 April 2023}} The software division began in 1984 with the development of a [[spreadsheet]] and [[Word processor program|word-processing]] suite but shifted to [[Offshore custom software development|offshore software development]] in 1990.{{cite news |title=Wipro: From vanaspati to IT leader |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/wipro-from-vanaspati-to-it-leader/articleshow/620317.cms |access-date=16 July 2024 |work=The Times of India |date=16 April 2004}} By the mid-1990s, Wipro had become one of India's leading manufacturers of [[personal computer]]s, [[peripheral]]s, and medical diagnostic equipment.{{cite news |title=The PC in India The Desktop Story |url=https://www.dqindia.com/the-pc-in-india-the-desktop-story/ |access-date=16 July 2024 |work=Dataquest |language=en}} In 1998, the company reported being the second-largest software exporter from India,{{cite news |title=Scaling New Highs |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/specials/scaling-new-highs-198081701012_1.html |access-date=17 July 2024 |work=Business Standard |date=17 August 1998}} and gradually increased its focus on the higher-[[Profit margin|margin]] software services business which accounted for the vast majority of its profits.{{cite news |title=Wipro software exports increase 49 per cent |url=https://www.rediff.com/computer/1998/jun/01wipro.htm |access-date=17 July 2024 |work=Rediff}} During the [[dot-com boom]] of the early 2000s, Wipro became the largest company in India by [[market capitalization]], reaching a value three times that of the next largest listed company, [[Infosys]]. Consequently, Wipro's majority shareholder Azim Premji was the [[Forbes India's richest Indian by year|richest Indian]] for five consecutive years.{{cite news |title=Wipro becomes most valuable Indian company, Azim Premji the richest Indian ever |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine/cover-story/story/20000306-wipro-becomes-most-valuable-indian-company-azim-premji-the-richest-indian-ever-777179-2000-03-05 |access-date=16 July 2024 |work=India Today |date=6 March 2000 |language=en}}{{cite news |title=India's $30 Billion Man |url=https://www.forbes.com/forbes/2000/0320/6507144a.html |access-date=16 July 2024 |work=Forbes |language=en}} In 2004, Wipro became the second listed [[List of Indian IT companies|Indian IT company]] to report annual revenues exceeding US$1 billion.{{Cite web|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/archive/wipro-joins-billion-dollar-club/104100/|title = Wipro Joins Billion Dollar Club|date = 17 April 2004|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220421110405/https://www.financialexpress.com/archive/wipro-joins-billion-dollar-club/104100/|archive-date=21 April 2022}} By 2006, approximately 30% of its total revenue came from [[Engineering design process|product engineering R&D]] services.{{cite news |title=Wipro plans further expansion in Chennai |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/wipro-plans-further-expansion-in-chennai-107013101030_1.html |access-date=4 August 2024 |work=Business Standard| date=31 January 2007}} In 2007, Wipro introduced a line of [[supercomputer]]s known as [[Wipro Supernova]].{{cite news |title=Wipro Infotech launches supercomputers |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/software/wipro-infotech-launches-supercomputers/articleshow/2362912.cms |access-date=19 July 2024 |work=The Economic Times |date=12 September 2007}} In 2011, Wipro, in collaboration with the [[Indian Space Research Organisation]] (ISRO), developed India's then-fastest supercomputer, [[SAGA-220]], which was deployed at the [[Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre]].{{cite news |last1=Chari |first1=Sridhar K. |title=Wipro building India's fastest supercomputer for space agency |url=https://www.livemint.com/Home-Page/opoGlRmGLYhOquHEFd6gDO/Wipro-building-India8217s-fastest-supercomputer-for-space.html |access-date=19 July 2024 |work=Mint |date=3 January 2011}}{{cite news |title=Isro stakes claim to India's fastest supercomputer |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/economy-policy/isro-stakes-claim-to-india-s-fastest-supercomputer-111050300042_1.html |access-date=19 July 2024 |work=Business Standard|date=3 May 2011}} In 2012, Wipro [[Demerger|demerged]] its non-IT businesses into a new private company named [[Wipro Enterprises]]. Prior to this demerger, these businesses—primarily in consumer care, lighting, furniture, hydraulics, water treatment, and medical diagnostics—accounted for about 14% of Wipro's total revenues.{{cite news |title=Wipro gets shareholders nod for demerger |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/wipro-gets-shareholders-nod-for-demerger-112122900015_1.html |access-date=19 July 2024 |work=Business Standard|date=29 December 2012}} In 2013, Wipro shut down its hardware division, discontinuing the manufacture of [[personal computers]], [[laptops]], and [[Server (computing)|servers]].{{cite news |last1=Sen |first1=Anirban |title=Wipro to log out of PC manufacturing business |url=https://www.livemint.com/Industry/hxZwPQJuK4QRHMurEKradP/Wipro-to-log-out-of-PC-manufacturing-business.html |access-date=10 June 2026 |work=mint |date=4 December 2013 |language=en}} In 2014, Wipro set up its [[User experience design|design]] and [[Mobile computing|mobility]] services business division called Wipro Digital.{{cite news |last1=Sood |first1=Varun |title=Wipro's digital business unit to be guided by Bhanumurthy Ballapuram |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/wipros-digital-business-unit-to-be-guided-by-bhanumurthy-ballapuram/articleshow/38945181.cms |access-date=17 July 2025 |work=The Economic Times |date=24 July 2014}} In 2015, Wipro established its strategic [[Investment (economics)|investment]] arm–Wipro Ventures–to invest in early- and mid-stage [[enterprise software]] startups and [[venture capital fund]]s in the US, India and Israel.{{cite news |last1=Rao |first1=Rukmini |title=Wipro Ventures secures $200 million in fresh funds, eyes bigger bets on startups |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/business-news/wipro-ventures-secures-200-million-in-fresh-funds-eyes-bigger-bets-on-startups/120838 |access-date=17 July 2025 |work=Fortune India |date=26 February 2025 |language=en}}{{cite news |last1=Hinchcliffe |first1=Dion |title=Exploring Wipro Ventures: An Enterprise-Focused Tech Incubator |url=https://www.constellationr.com/blog-news/exploring-wipro-ventures-enterprise-focused-tech-incubator |access-date=17 July 2025 |work=Constellation Research Inc. |date=16 August 2023 |language=en}} In 2021, Wipro reported that a third of its workforce was engaged in [[cloud computing|cloud]] projects, and announced a $1 billion investment in its FullStride Cloud Services vertical.{{cite news |last1=Dey |first1=Victor |title=Wipro Staffed A Third Of Its Workforce to Cloud Business, Says CEO |url=https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news-updates/wipro-staffed-a-third-of-its-workforce-to-cloud-business-says-ceo/ |access-date=25 July 2025 |work=Analytics India Magazine |date=30 November 2021 |language=en}} ==Operations== Wipro serves clients in industries such as financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, and telecommunications. As of 2025, its service offerings are divided under four global business lines (GBLs), each having different leaders:{{cite news |title=Wipro to realign its four global business lines starting April 1; here are the Big changes |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/technology/tech-news/wipro-to-realign-its-four-global-business-lines-starting-april-1-here-are-the-big-changes/articleshow/119073000.cms |access-date=25 July 2025 |work=The Times of India |date=16 March 2025}}{{cite web |title=Integrated Annual Report 2024-25 |url=https://bsmedia.business-standard.com/_media/bs/data/announcements/bse/21062025/bad4d97f-e94b-486a-b1ab-c50cd7ae0c75.pdf |website=Business Standard |publisher=Wipro |access-date=25 July 2025}} * Wipro Technology Services: IT services in [[Cloud computing|cloud]], [[cybersecurity]], [[data analytics]], [[artificial intelligence]], [[enterprise applications]], and [[Software design|design]], among other domains. * Wipro Consulting Services: Strategy advisory and [[Management consulting|business consulting]] services. * Wipro Engineering Edge: Engineering, research and development (ER&D) services for [[semiconductors]] and [[embedded systems]], [[Software-defined infrastructure|software-defined systems]], [[Industry 4.0]], and [[Communications system|communications]], among others. * Wipro Business Process Services: [[Business process management]] (BPM) services. ==Acquisitions== {| class="wikitable" |+ ! equity shares have been listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] since 1946 and the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] where it is a constituent of the [[NIFTY 50]]. The [[American depositary receipt|American Depositary Shares]] of the company are listed on the [[New York Stock Exchange]] (NYSE) since October 2000.{{cite news |title=Wipro IPO rises 19 percent |url=https://money.cnn.com/2000/10/19/deals/wipro_ipo/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240804064639/https://money.cnn.com/2000/10/19/deals/wipro_ipo/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=4 August 2024 |access-date=4 August 2024 |work=CNN Money| date=19 October 2000}} As of 2025, the promoter group headed by [[Azim Premji]] held a 72.67% stake in the company, while the remaining shares were with [[Public float|public shareholders]] and an [[employee trust]].{{cite news |title=Shareholding Pattern 2025 |url=https://www.wipro.com/content/dam/nexus/en/investor/shareholding-pattern/2025/june-13-2025.pdf |access-date=17 July 2025 |work=Wipro}} Since 2019, proceeds from the promoter group's 67% stake have been directed to the philanthropic activities of Azim Premji Foundation.{{cite news |title=Azim Premji commits Rs 1.45 lakh crore, 67 per cent Wipro stake to charity |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/business/story/azim-premji-wipro-shares-benefits-philanthropy-assets-1477361-2019-03-13 |access-date=25 July 2025 |work=India Today| date=13 March 2019}}{{cite news |last1=Sood |first1=Varun |title=Azim Premji trusts get a share of his wealth, but not voting rights |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/azim-premji-trusts-get-a-share-of-his-wealth-but-not-voting-rights-1552935688818.html |access-date=25 July 2025 |work=Mint |date=19 March 2019}} ==Employees== As of March 2024, Wipro had 234,054 employees from 146 nationalities, out of which 36.6% were women. extract: Wipro Limited ( ) is an Indian multinational technology company based in Bengaluru. It provides information technology, consulting and business process services, and is one of India's Big Six IT services companies. Wipro's services include cloud computing, computer security, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, robotics, data analytics, and other technologies.
